## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] chore: maintenance
- [ ] docs: documentation
- [ ] refactor: code restructuring
- [ ] test: test additions/fixes
- [ ] ci: CI/CD changes
- [ ] perf: performance improvement

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] TypeScript type checking passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] ESLint passes with zero errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Prettier format check passes (`npm run format`)
- [ ] All tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Coverage meets thresholds (statements >= 80%, branches >= 75%, functions >= 80%, lines >= 80%)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)

## Branch Protection

> This PR will be blocked from merging if any required status check fails.
> Required checks: TypeScript type checking, ESLint, Prettier format check,
> Commit message lint, Git hooks integrity, Unit tests, Build.
